title: Argalā Stotram
author: Durgā Saptaśatī, recited before chapter 1
intro: Argalā means a bolt or latch: this stotra is the key that opens the Durgā Saptaśatī, recited before its thirteen chapters. Most verses recall one of the Goddess's victories and end with the refrain rūpaṃ dehi jayaṃ dehi yaśo dehi dviṣo jahi, 'give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies'.
note: All verses are in Anuṣṭubh. Verses follow the commonly printed text (Gita Press numbering may differ by a verse or two).
